title: The Pink Gingham Friendsgiving Table
description: A pink gingham Friendsgiving table: a tasseled pink gingham tablecloth, pink pressed glass goblets, olive stoneware plates, gold flatware, velvet pumpkins and light pink taper candles.
intro: I host Friendsgiving because I like setting the table more than I like cooking. This year it's pink gingham with tassels, pink pressed glass goblets, olive green plates and gold flatware, with velvet pumpkins and tall pink candles down the middle. It looks like a lot of effort and it took me ten minutes.

sections.heading: The tablecloth
paragraphs: The JIALE pink gingham tablecloth with tassels, 55 by 75 inches. It does all the work, so everything else can stay simple.

sections.heading: Goblets, plates and flatware
paragraphs: Darlion pink pressed glass goblets, Amazon Basics stoneware dinner plates in Olive and a 20-piece gold flatware set. Pink and green with a little gold is my whole personality.

sections.heading: Down the middle
paragraphs: Winlyn velvet pumpkins in blush pink and white, plus a 4-pack of 10 inch light pink taper candles in clear holders.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The room, the food, the candle holders and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, colour and size before you buy.
